name: 80550 · Windsor, CO
findings: ZIP 80550 (Windsor) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80550 (Windsor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
